House pictures. Realtor, Zillow and Redfin block automated requests — a stealth scraper gets a 429 too — so the thumbnails are drawings of each block from OpenStreetMap street and building data. Three ways to get real photos in: open a house and use Add photo (a file) or Paste link (right-click a listing photo → Copy image address). You can also drag a file onto a thumbnail. Up to six photos per house — flip through them with the arrows, the dots, or the ←/→ keys. They save in this browser. You can also commit files to public/houses/1.jpg…14.jpg, or add a Google Maps key in public/config.js for automatic Street View.

#2, Colonial Trace could not be geocoded — the email says Colonial Trace Ln, Fort Worth 76244; the Realtor link says Colonial Trace Rd, Keller 76244.

Traffic and satellite layers need a paid Google Maps key; everything else here runs with no key at all. Checkmarks, times and notes save in this browser only.
